name: Shirasagi Otoha
source:
Nanagane Gakuen class 2-1 student.

Otoha lives in Tsukikan City. Her grades at school are excellent. She belongs to the brass band club and plays the flute well. [url=/c105362]Kamioi Ryuuichi[/url]'s childhood friend.
